Her parents were a part of the high elven fleet that accompanied Admiral [[Caelan]] and the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] and perished at the hands of the naga upon the shores of [[Gillijim's Isle]], in the shipwreck now known as [[Faelon's Folly]].
